HUNT.Install.Title: Hunt: Showdown RPG — Install rules
HUNT.Install.Body: Install the Hunt: Showdown rules in this world: 18 skills, the Health, Burned and Dread tracks, consequences, conditions, the four hunter aspects, the seven archetype stunts and the dark bayou theme, plus the arsenal (Hunt Arsenal) and the trait decks and player hands (Hunt Traits).
HUNT.Install.Warning: This replaces the world's current skills, tracks and aspects. Characters created before keep their old copy: recreate them afterwards. The page reloads when the install is done.
HUNT.Install.Done: Installing the Hunt rules… the page will reload.
HUNT.Install.NoSystem: Hunt: Showdown RPG needs the Fate Core Official system, set up in this world.
HUNT.Install.MenuHint: Replaces this world's skills, tracks, aspects, stunts and sheet theme with the Hunt: Showdown ones.
HUNT.Arsenal.MenuHint: Adds the arsenal to the Items directory (Hunt Arsenal folder: handguns, long guns, grenades, thrown and melee weapons, support items), or rewrites every arsenal item's stats from the module's data.
HUNT.Arsenal.Rebalanced: Hunt arsenal: {n} item(s) updated to the module's stats.
HUNT.Arsenal.Choice: Create only the items missing from the Hunt Arsenal folders, or rewrite the stats of every arsenal item (in the Items directory and on characters) from the module's data? Characters keep their loaded and spare rounds, weapon stress and charges.
HUNT.Arsenal.UpdateBalance: This update brings the full arsenal (85 items in six folders) and rebalanced weapon stats: power by range band, capacity, reliability and slots were reviewed with a damage simulation. Update the weapons already in this world and on characters to the new stats? Loaded and spare rounds are kept.
HUNT.Traits.MenuHint: Creates the three trait decks, the Played and Discarded piles, and a trait hand for each player who doesn't have one. Existing decks and hands are kept.
HUNT.Traits.Done: Hunt traits: {n} deck(s), pile(s) or hand(s) created.
HUNT.Creator.MenuHint: Build a monster from scratch or from a bestiary entry: skills, health, armour, dread, attacks, abilities and boss phases.
HUNT.Bestiary.MenuHint: Adds the Stillwater bestiary to the Actors directory (Hunt Bestiary folder), or rebuilds it from the module's data.
HUNT.Bestiary.Choice: Create only the monsters missing from the Hunt Bestiary folder, or rebuild every bestiary monster from the module's data? Rebuilding replaces them: tokens already on scenes keep their old stats.
HUNT.Bestiary.Rebalance: This update rebalances the five bosses (Fight 3, lower attack power) so they no longer down a hunter in one hit. Replace the bosses in the Hunt Bestiary folder with the new stats?
HUNT.Bestiary.Fire: This update adds fire: fire bombs and Burning kill ordinary monsters outright. The Meathead becomes fireproof and the Butcher's Fire Breath becomes a cone attack. Replace the Meathead and the Butcher in the Hunt Bestiary folder?
